name: PUBH 5504
title: Public Health Interventions in Disability
description: Final course in the Disability Studies in Public Health Certificate. Aligns with the 10 Essential Public Health Services. Critically examines public health systems and programs across the lifespan available to people with disabilities that impact health. Extends on foundational principles that are evidence-based and driven by epidemiologic studies of disability within the context of existing laws and policies.
requirement_description: PUBH 5501, 5502, and 5503; open only Disability Studies in Public Health certificate students, others by instructor consent.
